_comment: Narayana Hrudayalaya overrides. VERIFIED from user-uploaded Q4 FY26 and Q3 FY26 investor decks + Q3 FY26 concall transcript. CRITICAL INSIGHT: Narayana reports ARPOB as ₹Mn per ANNUM (not INR/day like other cos). Conversion: ₹Mn/year × 1e6 ÷ 365 = INR/day. Also Narayana's consolidated revenue (incl. UK from Nov 2025, Cayman) ≠ India-only revenue. Using consolidated to match how the company reports headline numbers. The +75.8% YoY Q4 FY26 growth is REAL (FY26 was a major expansion year incl. UK acquisition consolidated 6 Nov 2025).

FY27-Q1._source_pdfs: Narayana Q4 FY26 investor presentation (filed 22 May 2026)

revenue.note: Q4 FY26 consolidated operating revenue ₹25,938 Mn = ₹2,593.8 Cr (+75.8% YoY, +20.6% QoQ)

ebitda.note: Q4 FY26 consolidated EBITDA ₹5,392 Mn = ₹539.2 Cr

pat.note: Q4 FY26 consolidated PAT ₹2,280 Mn = ₹228 Cr

arpob.note: Q4 FY26 ARPOB = ₹18.6 Mn/annum ÷ 365 = ₹50,959/day. Narayana reports as Mn/year not INR/day.

operationalBeds.note: Q4 FY26 total network operational beds (India 5,451 + Cayman 164 + UK 330)

bedCapacity.note: Same as operational — Narayana doesn't disclose separate non-operational capacity

numberOfHospitals.note: 20 India hospitals/heart centres + 2 Cayman + 13 UK = 35 hospital facilities

netDebt.note: Q4 FY26 net debt ₹22,397 Mn = ₹2,239.7 Cr
